data.title: Ximen Mining Pursues Non-Dilutive Funding and Bridge Financing for Kenville Gold Mine
data.description:
Ximen Mining ( (TSE:XIM) ) has shared an announcement.

Ximen Mining Corp. is advancing preparations at its Kenville Gold Mine, with equipment on site, power connected, and only remaining preconditions and permit-related engineering work standing between the project and portal and decline construction. Management currently expects no material incremental capital outlays beyond the funds needed to execute the development work, and is targeting a late October 2026 start for portal construction, subject to financing, permits, contractors, and weather.

The company is negotiating non-dilutive funding structures to finance Kenville’s portal and mine development, aiming to minimize equity dilution for shareholders while advancing the project. To maintain near-term operations and keep its crew active as these talks continue, Ximen has launched a non-brokered bridge private placement of up to $350,000, with unit-based shares and warrants, providing short-term capital while it works to finalize a larger funding package and engage portal contractors.

The report, titled “Technical Report and Feasibility Study for the Black Pine Project, Idaho, USA,” is now available on SEDAR+ and the company’s website, providing formal technical disclosure for regulators and investors.

Prepared by a multi-disciplinary team of mining, metallurgical, environmental, and engineering consultants, the feasibility study underpins Liberty Gold’s efforts to de-risk Black Pine and supports its focus on technically simple, long-life gold assets in the U.S. Great Basin. The filing strengthens the project’s credibility and execution readiness, reinforcing Liberty Gold’s positioning as a developer of environmentally responsible heap leach gold projects and offering stakeholders greater visibility into the project’s path through permitting toward a possible build decision.

data.title: MPS Moves Closer to ADI BPO Merger as NCLT Clears Key Step
data.description:
MPS Limited ( (IN:MPSLTD) ) has shared an update.

MPS Limited has reported a key procedural development in its planned amalgamation with ADI BPO Services Limited, as the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) in Chennai has passed an order on the company’s second motion petition under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act. The order records that equity shareholders and unsecured creditors of MPS approved the scheme in meetings held on 22 August 2026, with the secured creditors’ meeting earlier dispensed with by the tribunal.

The NCLT has directed that notices be served to relevant statutory and regulatory authorities to invite any representations on the amalgamation scheme, marking progress toward final approval of the merger. MPS has made the tribunal’s order available on its website and notified stock exchanges promptly after receiving the certified copy, signaling ongoing transparency for investors and other stakeholders as it advances the consolidation with ADI BPO Services Limited.
